SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.PAGE_DESC: OLED/TFT display driver — themes, burn-in mitigation, quiet hours.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_THEME_DESC: Pick a theme. Default ships with the plugin; custom themes can be uploaded as a zip.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_ACTIVE_THEME_DESC: Switching themes restarts the display service.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_THEMES_MANAGE_DESC: Upload, download, and delete themes. Upload accepts a path to a .zip file on the device; deletes apply immediately.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_UPLOAD_PATH: Path to theme .zip on the device
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.FIELD_UPLOAD_PATH_DESC: Place your zip somewhere on the Pi (via SCP or Volumio's file manager), then paste the absolute path here.
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.INFO_NO_DELETABLE: No themes available to delete (default and active themes are protected).
SYNTHWAVE_DISPLAY.SECTION_BURNIN_DESC: OLED panels can ghost from static UI. These defenses run at near-zero cost.
